Chapter 11

Deployments and ReplicaSetsDeployment 与 ReplicaSet

A major strength of Kubernetes lies in its ability to scale applications seamlessly and manage replication with ease. To enable these capabilities, Kubernetes provides two primitives: Deployments and ReplicaSets.

Kubernetes 的一大优势在于能够无缝地扩展应用、轻松地管理副本。为实现这些能力，Kubernetes 提供了两个原语：Deployment 与 ReplicaSet。

In this chapter, you'll learn how to create a Deployment, which leverages a ReplicaSet behind the scenes to manage and scale a group of identical Pods. Deployments also make it easy to roll out updates to your application and, if needed, roll back to a previous version—all with minimal downtime and maximum control.

本章你将学习如何创建 Deployment，它在幕后借助 ReplicaSet 来管理和扩展一组相同的 Pod。Deployment 还能让你方便地为应用推出更新，并在需要时回滚到之前的版本——全程停机时间最短、掌控力最大。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives考试大纲覆盖范围

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objectives: - Understand application deployments and how to perform rolling update and rollbacks - Understand the primitives used to create robust, self-healing, application deployments

本章对应以下考试大纲目标： - 理解应用部署，以及如何执行滚动更新与回滚 - 理解用于创建健壮、自愈的应用部署的原语

Working with Deployments使用 Deployment

The primitive for running an application in a container is the Pod. Using a single instance of a Pod to operate an application has its flaws—it represents a single point of failure because all traffic targeting the application is funneled to this Pod. This behavior is specifically problematic when the load increases due to higher demand (e.g., during peak shopping season for an ecommerce application or when an increasing number of microservices communicate with a centralized microservice functionality, like an authentication provider).

在容器中运行应用的原语是 Pod。用单个 Pod 实例来运行应用存在缺陷——它是一个单点故障，因为所有指向该应用的流量都被集中到这个 Pod 上。当负载因需求增长而上升时（例如电商应用在购物旺季，或越来越多的微服务与某个集中式微服务功能（如认证服务）通信时），这种行为尤其成问题。

— PDF p.163 —

Another important aspect of running an application in a Pod is failure tolerance. The scheduler cluster component will not reschedule a Pod in the case of a node failure, which can lead to a system outage for end users. In this chapter, we'll look at the Kubernetes mechanics that support application scalability and failure tolerance.

在 Pod 中运行应用的另一个重要方面是故障容忍。当节点发生故障时，调度器不会重新调度该 Pod，这可能导致终端用户的系统中断。本章我们将研究支持应用可扩展性和故障容忍的 Kubernetes 机制。

A ReplicaSet is a Kubernetes API resource that controls multiple, identical instances of a Pod running the application, called replicas. It has the capability of scaling the number of replicas up or down on demand.

ReplicaSet 是一种 Kubernetes API 资源，它控制运行该应用的多个相同 Pod 实例（称为副本）。它能够按需增加或减少副本数量。

A Deployment abstracts the functionality of ReplicaSet and manages it internally. In practice, this means you do not have to create, modify, or delete ReplicaSet objects yourself. The Deployment keeps a history of application versions and can delegate toward the ReplicaSet to roll back to an older version to counteract a blocking or potentially costly production issue. Furthermore, it offers the capability of scaling the number of replicas.

Deployment 对 ReplicaSet 的功能做了抽象，并在内部管理它。实际使用中，这意味着你不必自己创建、修改或删除 ReplicaSet 对象。Deployment 会保留应用版本历史，并可以委托 ReplicaSet 回滚到旧版本，以应对阻塞性或代价高昂的生产问题。此外，它还提供扩缩副本数量的能力。

Figure 11-1 illustrates the relationship between a Deployment, a ReplicaSet, and its controlled replicas.

图 11-1 展示了 Deployment、ReplicaSet 及其所控制副本之间的关系。

The following sections explain how to manage Deployments, including scaling and rollout features.

接下来的小节将讲解如何管理 Deployment，包括扩缩容与发布功能。

Creating Deployments创建 Deployment

You can create a Deployment using the imperative command create deployment. The command offers a range of options, some of which are mandatory. At a minimum, you need to provide the name of the Deployment and the container image. The

你可以使用命令式命令 create deployment 来创建 Deployment。该命令提供一系列选项，其中一些是必填的。至少需要提供 Deployment 的名称和容器镜像。

— PDF p.164 —

Deployment passes this information to the ReplicaSet, which uses it to manage the replicas. The default number of replicas created is one; however, you can define a higher number of replicas using the option --replicas.

Deployment 把这些信息传给 ReplicaSet，后者用它来管理副本。默认创建的副本数为 1；不过你可以用 --replicas 选项指定更多副本。

Let's observe the command in action. The following command creates the Deployment named app-cache, which runs the object cache memcached inside the container on four replicas:

下面我们看一下命令的实际效果。以下命令创建名为 app-cache 的 Deployment，在容器中运行对象缓存 memcached，副本数为 4：

$ kubectl create deployment app-cache --image=memcached:1.6.8 --replicas=4
deployment.apps/app-cache created

The mapping between the Deployment and the replicas it controls happens through label selection. When you run the imperative command, kubectl sets up the mapping for you. Example 11-1 shows the label selection in the YAML manifest. This YAML manifest can be used to create a Deployment declaratively or by inspecting the live object created by the previous imperative command.

Deployment 与其所控制副本之间的映射通过标签选择器完成。运行命令式命令时，kubectl 会自动为你建立该映射。示例 11-1 展示了 YAML 清单中的标签选择器。你可以用这份 YAML 清单以声明式方式创建 Deployment，也可以通过查看前述命令式命令创建的在线对象来得到它。

Example 11-1. A YAML manifest for a Deployment

示例 11-1. 一份 Deployment 的 YAML 清单

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app-cache
  labels:
    app: app-cache
spec:
  replicas: 4
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app-cache
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app-cache
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: memcached
        image: memcached:1.6.8

When created by the imperative command, app is the label key the Deployment uses by default. You can find this key in three different places in the YAML output:

用命令式命令创建时，app 是 Deployment 默认使用的标签键。你可以在 YAML 输出的三个不同位置找到这个键：

  • metadata.labelsmetadata.labels
  • spec.selector.matchLabelsspec.selector.matchLabels
  • spec.template.metadata.labelsspec.template.metadata.labels
— PDF p.165 —

For label selection to work properly, the assignment of spec.selector.matchLabels and spec.template.metadata needs to match, as shown in Figure 11-2. Object creation will fail with an appropriate error message if the values of both assignments do not match.

要让标签选择器正常工作，spec.selector.matchLabels 与 spec.template.metadata 的赋值必须匹配，如图 11-2 所示。若两处取值不匹配，对象创建会失败并给出相应的错误信息。

The values of metadata.labels is irrelevant for mapping the Deployment to the Pod template. As you can see in the figure, the label assignment to metadata.labels has been changed deliberately to deploy: app-cache to underline that it is not important for the Deployment to Pod template selection.

metadata.labels 的取值对 Deployment 与 Pod 模板之间的映射无关紧要。如图所示，metadata.labels 的标签值被刻意改成了 deploy: app-cache，以强调它对 Deployment 与 Pod 模板的选择并不重要。

Listing Deployments, ReplicaSets, and Their Pods列出 Deployment、ReplicaSet 及其 Pod

You can inspect a Deployment after its creation by using the get deployments command. The output of the command renders the important details of its replicas, as shown here:

Deployment 创建后，你可以使用 get deployments 命令查看它。该命令的输出会呈现其副本的关键细节，如下所示：

$ kubectl get deployments
NAME        READY   UP-TO-DATE   AVAILABLE   AGE
app-cache   4/4     4            4           125m

The column titles relevant to the replicas controlled by the Deployment are shown in Table 11-1.

与 Deployment 所控制副本相关的列名如表 11-1 所示。

— PDF p.166 —

Table 11-1. Runtime replica information when listing deployments

表 11-1. 列出 Deployment 时的运行时副本信息

Column titleDescription
READYLists the number of replicas available to end users in the format of <ready>/<desired>. The number of desired replicas corresponds to the value of spec.replicas.
READY以 <ready>/<desired> 格式列出可供终端用户使用的副本数。期望副本数对应 spec.replicas 的值。
UP-TO-DATELists the number of replicas that have been updated to achieve the desired state.
UP-TO-DATE列出已更新到期望状态的副本数。
AVAILABLELists the number of replicas available to end users.
AVAILABLE列出可供终端用户使用的副本数。

You can identify the Pods controlled by the Deployment by their naming prefix. In the case of the previously created Deployment, the names for ReplicaSet and its Pods start with app-cache-. The hash following the prefix is autogenerated and appended to the name upon creation:

你可以通过命名前缀识别 Deployment 所控制的 Pod。对于前面创建的 Deployment，ReplicaSet 及其 Pod 的名称都以 app-cache- 开头。前缀后面的哈希值是自动生成的，并在创建时追加到名称上：

$ kubectl get replicasets,pods
NAME                                   DESIRED   CURRENT   READY   AGE
replicaset.apps/app-cache-596bc5586d   4         4         4       6h5m

NAME                         READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
app-cache-596bc5586d-84dkv   1/1     Running   0          6h5m
app-cache-596bc5586d-8bzfs   1/1     Running   0          6h5m
app-cache-596bc5586d-rc257   1/1     Running   0          6h5m
app-cache-596bc5586d-tvm4d   1/1     Running   0          6h5m

Rendering Deployment Details查看 Deployment 详情

You can render the details of a Deployment. Those details include the label selection criteria, which can be extremely valuable when troubleshooting a misconfigured Deployment. The following output provides the full details:

你可以查看 Deployment 的详情。这些详情包括标签选择条件，在排查配置错误的 Deployment 时极其有用。以下输出给出了完整详情：

$ kubectl describe deployment app-cache

— PDF p.167 —
  Volumes:        <none>
Conditions:
  Type           Status  Reason
  ----           ------  ------

You might have noticed that the output contains a reference to a ReplicaSet. The purpose of a ReplicaSet is to replicate a set of identical Pods. You do not need to deeply understand the core functionality of a ReplicaSet for the exam. Just be aware that the Deployment automatically creates the ReplicaSet and uses the Deployment's name as a prefix for the ReplicaSet, similar to the Pods it controls. In the case of the previous Deployment named app-cache, the name of the ReplicaSet is app-cache-596bc5586d.

你可能已经注意到输出中引用了一个 ReplicaSet。ReplicaSet 的作用是复制一组相同的 Pod。考试中你不需要深入理解 ReplicaSet 的核心功能，只需知道 Deployment 会自动创建 ReplicaSet，并以 Deployment 的名称作为 ReplicaSet 的前缀，与它所控制的 Pod 类似。对于前面名为 app-cache 的 Deployment，其 ReplicaSet 的名称是 app-cache-596bc5586d。

Replica Replacement副本替换

The ReplicaSet in Kubernetes ensures that a specified number of replicas are running at all times. If a Pod fails or is deleted, Kubernetes automatically creates a replacement Pod to maintain the desired replica count. This behavior is one of Kubernetes' key self-healing capabilities.

Kubernetes 中的 ReplicaSet 会确保始终运行指定数量的副本。如果某个 Pod 失败或被删除，Kubernetes 会自动创建一个替换 Pod 来维持期望的副本数。这是 Kubernetes 关键的自愈能力之一。

You can easily observe this in action by manually deleting one of the Pods managed by the ReplicaSet. Let's assume the ReplicaSet and Pod objects shown here:

你只需手动删除 ReplicaSet 管理的某个 Pod，就能轻松观察到这一行为。假设当前的 ReplicaSet 和 Pod 对象如下：

$ kubectl get replicasets,pods
NAME                                   DESIRED   CURRENT   READY   AGE
replicaset.apps/app-cache-596bc5586d   4         4         4       6h47m

NAME                             READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
pod/app-cache-596bc5586d-84dkv   1/1     Running   0          6h47m
pod/app-cache-596bc5586d-8bzfs   1/1     Running   0          6h47m
pod/app-cache-596bc5586d-rc257   1/1     Running   0          6h47m
pod/app-cache-596bc5586d-tvm4d   1/1     Running   0          6h47m

You can delete any of the Pods controlled by the ReplicaSet, i.e., the Pod named app-cache-596bc5586d-rc257:

你可以删除 ReplicaSet 控制的任意 Pod，例如名为 app-cache-596bc5586d-rc257 的 Pod：

$ kubectl delete pod app-cache-596bc5586d-rc257
pod "app-cache-596bc5586d-rc257" deleted

Shortly after deleting the Pod manually, a new one will be created by the ReplicaSet. You can easily identify the newly-created Pod by its AGE value. In the following output, the Pod is only five seconds old:

手动删除 Pod 后不久，ReplicaSet 就会创建一个新 Pod。你可以通过 AGE 字段轻松识别新创建的 Pod。在下面的输出中，该 Pod 仅存在了 5 秒：

— PDF p.168 —
$ kubectl get replicasets,pods
NAME                                   DESIRED   CURRENT   READY   AGE
replicaset.apps/app-cache-596bc5586d   4         4         4       6h47m

NAME                             READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
pod/app-cache-596bc5586d-84dkv   1/1     Running   0          6h47m
pod/app-cache-596bc5586d-8bzfs   1/1     Running   0          6h47m
pod/app-cache-596bc5586d-lwflz   1/1     Running   0          5s
pod/app-cache-596bc5586d-tvm4d   1/1     Running   0          6h47m

Similar to the Deployment, other workload primitives like the StatefulSet and the DaemonSet manage a ReplicaSet to control a set of replicas.

与 Deployment 类似，其他工作负载原语（如 StatefulSet 和 DaemonSet）也通过管理 ReplicaSet 来控制一组副本。

For the StatefulSet, the replica replacement behavior is the same as for the Deployment. If a Pod fails as part of a DaemonSet, the control plane node ensures that the Pod replacement is run on the same node it was scheduled on before. The primitives StatefulSet and DaemonSet are out-of-scope for the exam; however, later chapters may mention them again.

对 StatefulSet 而言，副本替换行为与 Deployment 相同。如果属于 DaemonSet 的某个 Pod 失败，控制平面会确保替换 Pod 仍然运行在它之前被调度的那个节点上。StatefulSet 和 DaemonSet 不在考试范围内，但后续章节可能还会提到它们。

Deleting a Deployment删除 Deployment

A Deployment takes full charge of the creation and deletion of the objects it controls: ReplicaSets and Pods. When you delete a Deployment, the corresponding objects are deleted as well. Say you are dealing with the following set of objects shown in the output:

Deployment 全权负责它所控制对象（ReplicaSet 和 Pod）的创建与删除。删除 Deployment 时，相关对象也会一并被删除。假设你面对如下输出所示的一组对象：

$ kubectl get deployments,replicasets,pods
NAME                        READY   UP-TO-DATE   AVAILABLE   AGE
deployment.apps/app-cache   4/4     4            4           6h47m

NAME                                   DESIRED   CURRENT   READY   AGE
replicaset.apps/app-cache-596bc5586d   4         4         4       6h47m

NAME                             READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
pod/app-cache-596bc5586d-84dkv   1/1     Running   0          6h47m
pod/app-cache-596bc5586d-8bzfs   1/1     Running   0          6h47m
pod/app-cache-596bc5586d-rc257   1/1     Running   0          6h47m
pod/app-cache-596bc5586d-tvm4d   1/1     Running   0          6h47m

Run the delete deployment command for a cascading deletion of its managed objects:

运行 delete deployment 命令，会级联删除其管理的对象：

$ kubectl delete deployment app-cache
deployment.apps "app-cache" deleted
$ kubectl get deployments,replicasets,pods
No resources found in default namespace.
— PDF p.169 —

Performing Rolling Updates and Rollbacks执行滚动更新与回滚

A Deployment fully abstracts rollout and rollback capabilities by delegating this responsibility to the ReplicaSet(s) it manages. Once a user changes the definition of the Pod template in a Deployment, Kubernetes will create a new ReplicaSet that applies the changes to the replicas it controls and then shut down the previous ReplicaSet. In this section, we'll see both scenarios: deploying a new version of an application and reverting to an old version of an application.

Deployment 通过把发布与回滚的职责委托给它所管理的 ReplicaSet，完整地抽象了这两项能力。一旦用户修改 Deployment 中 Pod 模板的定义，Kubernetes 就会创建一个新的 ReplicaSet，把变更应用到它所控制的副本上，然后关闭旧的 ReplicaSet。本节我们将看到两种场景：部署应用新版本，以及回退到应用旧版本。

Updating a Deployment's Pod Template更新 Deployment 的 Pod 模板

You can choose from a range of options to update the definition of replicas controlled by a Deployment. Any of those options is valid, but they vary in ease of use and operational environment.

你可以从多种方式中选择一种来更新 Deployment 所控制副本的定义。这些方式都可行，但在易用性和运行环境上各有不同。

Applying changes declaratively

以声明式方式应用变更

In real-world projects, you should check your manifest files into version control. Changes to the definition would then be made by directly editing the file. The kubectl apply command can update a live object by pointing to the changed manifest:

在实际项目中，你应当把清单文件纳入版本控制。对定义的修改通过直接编辑文件完成。kubectl apply 命令可以通过指向变更后的清单来更新在线对象：

$ kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml

Editing the object from the default editor

用默认编辑器编辑对象

The kubectl edit command lets you change the Pod template interactively by modifying the live object's manifest in an editor. To edit the Deployment live object named web-server, use the following command:

kubectl edit 命令让你在编辑器中修改在线对象的清单，从而交互式地更改 Pod 模板。要编辑名为 web-server 的 Deployment 在线对象，使用以下命令：

$ kubectl edit deployment web-server

Updating the container image imperatively

以命令式方式更新容器镜像

The imperative kubectl set image command changes only the container image assigned to a Pod template by selecting the name of the container. For example, you could use this command to assign the image nginx:1.25.2 to the container named nginx in the Deployment web-server:

命令式命令 kubectl set image 只通过选择容器名称来更改分配给 Pod 模板的容器镜像。例如，你可以用这条命令把镜像 nginx:1.25.2 分配给 Deployment web-server 中名为 nginx 的容器：

$ kubectl set image deployment web-server nginx=nginx:1.25.2

Replacing an existing object

替换现有对象

The kubectl replace command lets you replace the existing Deployment with a new definition that contains your change to the manifest. The optional --force flag first deletes the existing object and then creates it from scratch. The following command assumes that you changed the container image assignment in deployment.yaml:

kubectl replace 命令让你用一份包含清单变更的新定义替换现有 Deployment。可选的 --force 标志会先删除现有对象，再从头创建它。以下命令假设你已在 deployment.yaml 中修改了容器镜像分配：

— PDF p.170 —
$ kubectl replace -f deployment.yaml

Updating fields of an object using a JSON patch

用 JSON patch 更新对象字段

The command kubectl patch requires you to provide the merges as a patch to update a Deployment. The following command shows the operation in action. Here, you are sending the changes to be made in the form of a JSON structure:

kubectl patch 命令要求你以 patch 形式提供合并内容来更新 Deployment。以下命令展示了该操作的实际效果。这里你以 JSON 结构的形式发送要做的变更：

$ kubectl patch deployment web-server -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"nginx","image":"nginx:1.25.2"}]}}}}'

Rolling Out a New Revision发布新版本

The Deployment primitive employs rolling update as the default deployment strategy, also referred to as ramped deployment. It's called "ramped" because the Deployment gradually transitions replicas from the old version to a new version in batches. The Deployment automatically creates a new ReplicaSet for the desired change after the user updates the Pod template.

Deployment 原语默认采用滚动更新（rolling update）作为部署策略，也称为渐进式部署（ramped deployment）。之所以称为"渐进"，是因为 Deployment 会分批逐步把副本从旧版本迁移到新版本。用户更新 Pod 模板后，Deployment 会自动为期望的变更创建一个新的 ReplicaSet。

Figure 11-3 shows a snapshot in time during the rollout process.

图 11-3 展示了发布过程中的一个时间快照。

In this scenario, the user initiated an update of the application version from 1.0.0 to 2.0.0. As a result, the Deployment creates a new ReplicaSet and starts up Pods running the new application version while at the same time scaling down the old version. The Service routes network traffic to either the old or new version of the application. The runtime behavior of the deployment strategy can be further customized. Refer to the documentation to see the configuration options.

在该场景中，用户发起了把应用版本从 1.0.0 更新到 2.0.0 的操作。于是 Deployment 创建一个新的 ReplicaSet，启动运行新版本应用的 Pod，同时缩容旧版本。Service 把网络流量路由到应用的旧版本或新版本。部署策略的运行时行为还可以进一步定制，请查阅文档了解可配置项。

Say you want to upgrade the version of memcached from 1.6.8 to 1.6.10 to benefit from the latest features and bug fixes. All you need to do is change the desired state of the object by updating the Pod template. The command set image offers a quick, convenient way to change the image of a Deployment, as shown in the following command:

假设你想把 memcached 从 1.6.8 升级到 1.6.10，以受益于最新特性和 bug 修复。你只需更新 Pod 模板来改变对象的期望状态。set image 命令提供了一种快速、便捷的方式来更改 Deployment 的镜像，如下所示：

— PDF p.171 —
$ kubectl set image deployment app-cache memcached=memcached:1.6.10
deployment.apps/app-cache image updated

You can check the current status of a rollout that's in progress using the command rollout status. The output indicates the number of replicas that have already been updated since emitting the command:

你可以使用 rollout status 命令查看正在进行的发布的当前状态。输出会显示自命令发出以来已更新的副本数：

$ kubectl rollout status deployment app-cache
Waiting for rollout to finish: 2 out of 4 new replicas have been updated...
deployment "app-cache" successfully rolled out

Kubernetes keeps track of the changes you make to a Deployment over time in the rollout history. Every change is represented by a revision. When changing the Pod template of a Deployment—for example, by updating the image—the Deployment triggers the creation of a new ReplicaSet. The Deployment will gradually perform the migrating by decreasing the replica count of the old ReplicaSet and increasing the count on the new ReplicaSet. You can check the rollout history by running the following command. You will see two revisions listed:

Kubernetes 会在发布历史中记录你对 Deployment 随时间所做的变更。每次变更都由一个修订版本（revision）表示。当你更改 Deployment 的 Pod 模板（例如更新镜像）时，Deployment 会触发创建新的 ReplicaSet。Deployment 会逐步完成迁移：减少旧 ReplicaSet 的副本数，增加新 ReplicaSet 的副本数。你可以运行以下命令查看发布历史，会看到列出两个修订版本：

$ kubectl rollout history deployment app-cache
deployment.apps/app-cache
REVISION  CHANGE-CAUSE
1         <none>
2         <none>

The first revision was recorded for the original state of the Deployment when you created the object. The second revision was added for changing the image tag.

第一个修订版本记录的是你创建对象时 Deployment 的初始状态；第二个修订版本是在更改镜像标签时新增的。

Configurable revision history可配置的修订历史

By default, a Deployment persists for a maximum of 10 revisions in its history. You can change the limit by assigning a different value to spec.revisionHistoryLimit.

默认情况下，Deployment 在历史中最多保留 10 个修订版本。你可以通过给 spec.revisionHistoryLimit 赋不同的值来更改该上限。

To get a more detailed view of the revision, run the following command. You can see that the image uses the value memcached:1.6.10:

要查看某个修订版本的更详细信息，运行以下命令。可以看到镜像使用的是 memcached:1.6.10：

$ kubectl rollout history deployments app-cache --revision=2
deployment.apps/app-cache with revision #2
Pod Template:
  Labels:       app=app-cache
	pod-template-hash=596bc5586d
  Containers:
   memcached:
    Image:      memcached:1.6.10
    Port:       <none>
    Host Port:  <none>
    Environment:        <none>
    Mounts:     <none>
  Volumes:      <none>
— PDF p.172 —

The rolling update strategy ensures that the application is always available to end users. This approach implies that two versions of the same application are available during the update process. As an application developer, you have to be aware that convenience doesn't come without potential side effects. If you happen to introduce a breaking change to the public API of your application, you might temporarily break consumers, as they could hit revision 1 or 2 of the application.

滚动更新策略确保应用始终对终端用户可用。这种方式意味着在更新过程中，同一应用的两个版本会同时可用。作为应用开发者，你必须意识到这种便利并非没有潜在副作用。如果你对应用的公共 API 引入了破坏性变更，可能会临时影响调用方，因为他们可能访问到应用的修订版本 1 或 2。

You can change the default deployment strategy by providing a different value to the attribute spec.strategy.type; however, consider the trade-offs. The value Recreate kills all Pods first, then creates new Pods with the latest revision, causing potential downtime for consumers.

你可以通过给 spec.strategy.type 属性赋不同的值来更改默认部署策略，但要权衡利弊。Recreate 取值会先杀掉所有 Pod，再用最新修订版本创建新 Pod，可能导致调用方停机。

Adding a Change Cause for a Revision为修订版本添加变更原因

The rollout history renders the column CHANGE-CAUSE. You can populate the information for a revision to document why you introduced a new change or which kubectl command you use to make the change.

发布历史会显示 CHANGE-CAUSE 列。你可以为某个修订版本填写该信息，以记录你为何引入新变更，或用了哪条 kubectl 命令做的变更。

By default, changing the Pod template does not automatically record a change cause. To add a change cause to the current revision, add an annotation with the reserved key kubernetes.io/change-cause to the Deployment object. The following imperative annotate command assigns the change cause "Image updated to 1.6.10":

默认情况下，更改 Pod 模板不会自动记录变更原因。要为当前修订版本添加变更原因，需要给 Deployment 对象添加一个使用保留键 kubernetes.io/change-cause 的注解。以下命令式 annotate 命令把变更原因设为 "Image updated to 1.6.10"：

$ kubectl annotate deployment app-cache kubernetes.io/change-cause="Image updated to 1.6.10"
deployment.apps/app-cache annotated

The rollout history now renders the change cause value for the current revision:

发布历史现在会显示当前修订版本的变更原因：

$ kubectl rollout history deployment app-cache
deployment.apps/app-cache
REVISION  CHANGE-CAUSE
1         <none>
2         Image updated to 1.6.10

Rolling Back to a Previous Revision回滚到先前修订版本

Problems can arise in production that require swift action. For example, the container image you just rolled out contains a crucial bug. Kubernetes gives you the option to roll back to one of the previous revisions in the rollout history. You can achieve this by using the rollout undo command. To pick a specific revision, provide the command-line option --to-revision. The command rolls back to the previous revision if you do not provide the option. Here, we are rolling back to revision 1:

生产环境可能出现需要快速处理的问题。例如，你刚发布的容器镜像包含一个严重 bug。Kubernetes 允许你回滚到发布历史中的某个先前修订版本。你可以使用 rollout undo 命令实现。要指定某个修订版本，提供命令行选项 --to-revision。若不提供该选项，命令会回滚到上一个修订版本。这里我们回滚到修订版本 1：

$ kubectl rollout undo deployment app-cache --to-revision=1
deployment.apps/app-cache rolled back

As a result, Kubernetes performs a rolling update to all replicas with the revision 1.

结果是 Kubernetes 会对所有副本执行一次滚动更新，使其回到修订版本 1。

— PDF p.173 —
Rollbacks and persistent data回滚与持久化数据

The rollout undo command does not restore any persistent data associated with applications. It only reverts the Deployment's Pod template (.spec.template) to a previous revision. Other Deployment settings, such as the replica count, remain unchanged.

rollout undo 命令不会恢复与应用关联的任何持久化数据。它只把 Deployment 的 Pod 模板（.spec.template）回退到先前修订版本。其他 Deployment 设置（如副本数）保持不变。

The rollout history now lists revision 3. Given that we rolled back to revision 1, there's no more need to keep that entry as a duplicate. Kubernetes simply turns revision 1 into 3 and removes 1 from the list:

发布历史现在列出修订版本 3。既然我们回滚到了修订版本 1，就没有必要再保留该条目作为副本。Kubernetes 直接把修订版本 1 改为 3，并从列表中移除 1：

$ kubectl rollout history deployment app-cache
deployment.apps/app-cache
REVISION  CHANGE-CAUSE
2         Image updated to 1.16.10
3         <none>

Summary本章小结

The Deployment is an essential primitive for providing declarative updates and lifecycle management of Pods. The ReplicaSet performs the heavy lifting of managing those Pods, commonly referred to as replicas. A Deployment manages the ReplicaSet under the hood.

Deployment 是为 Pod 提供声明式更新和生命周期管理的关键原语。ReplicaSet 承担了管理这些 Pod（通常称为副本）的繁重工作。Deployment 在幕后管理 ReplicaSet。

Deployments can easily roll out and roll back revisions of the application represented by an image running in the container. In this chapter you learned about the commands for controlling the revision history and its operations.

Deployment 可以轻松地发布和回滚由容器中运行镜像所代表的应用修订版本。本章你学习了控制修订历史及其操作的命令。

Exam Essentials考试要点

  • Know the ins and outs of a Deployment. Given that a Deployment is such a central primitive in Kubernetes, you can expect that the exam will test you on it. Know how to create and configure a Deployment.精通 Deployment 的方方面面。鉴于 Deployment 是 Kubernetes 中如此核心的原语，可以预期考试会考查它。要知道如何创建和配置 Deployment。
  • Understand how the ReplicaSet supports replication. Learn how to scale to multiple replicas. One of the superior features of a ReplicaSet is its rollout functionality for new revisions. Practice how to roll out a new revision, inspect the rollout history, and roll back to a previous revision.理解 ReplicaSet 如何支持复制。学习如何扩展到多个副本。ReplicaSet 的一大优秀特性是它对新修订版本的发布功能。练习如何发布新修订版本、查看发布历史、回滚到先前修订版本。
  • Differentiate the built-in deployment strategies. Learn how to configure the built-in strategies in the Deployment primitive and their options for fine-tuning the runtime behavior. You can implement even more sophisticated deployment scenarios with the help of the Deployment and Service primitives. Examples are the blue-green and canary deployment strategies, which require a multiphased rollout process, but will not be covered by the exam.区分内置的部署策略。学习如何在 Deployment 原语中配置内置策略及其用于微调运行时行为的选项。借助 Deployment 和 Service 原语，你还可以实现更复杂的部署场景，例如蓝绿部署和金丝雀部署策略——它们需要多阶段发布过程，但不在考试范围内。
— PDF p.174 —

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的解答见附录 A。

  1. A team member wrote a Deployment manifest but has trouble with creating the object from it. Help with finding the issue. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch11/misconfigured-deployment of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Run a kubectl command to create the Deployment object defined in the file fix-me-deployment.yaml. Inspect the error message. Fix the Deployment manifest so that the object can be created.一位团队成员写了一份 Deployment 清单，但无法从中创建对象。帮忙找出问题。进入已克隆的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 的目录 app-a/ch11/misconfigured-deployment。运行 kubectl 命令创建文件 fix-me-deployment.yaml 中定义的 Deployment 对象。查看错误信息。修复 Deployment 清单，使对象能够被创建。
  2. Create a Deployment named nginx with three replicas. The Pods should use the nginx:1.23.0 image and the name nginx. The Deployment uses the label tier=backend. The Pod template should use the label app=v1. List the Deployment and ensure that the correct number of replicas is running. Update the image to nginx:1.23.4. Verify that the change has been rolled out to all replicas. Assign the change cause "Pick up patch version" to the revision. Have a look at the Deployment rollout history. Revert the Deployment to revision 1. Ensure that the Pods use the image nginx:1.23.0.创建一个名为 nginx、拥有三个副本的 Deployment。Pod 应使用 nginx:1.23.0 镜像，容器名为 nginx。Deployment 使用标签 tier=backend。Pod 模板应使用标签 app=v1。列出 Deployment，确认正确数量的副本正在运行。把镜像更新为 nginx:1.23.4。验证变更已发布到所有副本。为该修订版本指定变更原因 "Pick up patch version"。查看 Deployment 发布历史。把 Deployment 回滚到修订版本 1。确认 Pod 使用的镜像为 nginx:1.23.0。
— PDF p.175 —
